## industrial_cutaway_view

> Isometric cutaway / exploded view of an industrial machine with four labeled internal components.

**Artifact:** `diagram`, `1536x1024`, aspect `3:2`
**Demo vars:** `templates/industrial/_vars_examples/industrial_cutaway_view.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A 3:2 isometric cutaway drawing of Helio HX-220 Centrifugal Pump, with the outer housing partially removed or split open to reveal four internal components: Volute housing, Impeller assembly, Mechanical seal, and Bearing cartridge. Each component is annotated with a small numbered callout circle connected to its label by a thin leader line.
[2. Action] The diagram is static and pedagogical — the viewer is meant to locate each numbered callout, follow its leader to the labeled component, and build a mental map of the assembly. No motion lines, no in-use animation, no operator hands; this is a service-manual reference figure.
[3. Scene] Document-grade flat field: a soft warm off-white background with no drop shadow under the machine. Subtle ground line indicates orientation but no environmental context. The cutaway interior should appear naturally lit by even diffuse ambient lighting, suitable for printed manuals.
[4. Composition] Horizontal 3:2 frame. Machine occupies the central ~70% of the frame, isometric viewpoint pitched ~30 degrees from horizontal. Two callouts attach on the left side, two on the right, each leader line ending in a small numbered circle above its short label. Title band at top ~9% with the machine name. Each label kept under one line; numbers (1-4) match callout circles for unambiguous mapping.
[5. Style] Technical-illustration aesthetic, descended from mid-century engineering manuals. Palette: muted steel greys for the housing, two restrained accents (signal red and signal blue) reserved for callouts and exposed inner components. Line weights graded — heavier outer silhouette, thinner internal detail. Cross-hatching permitted on cut surfaces; no photorealism, no glossy reflections, no 3D rendered chrome.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- machine_name: "Helio HX-220 Centrifugal Pump"
- label1: "1. Volute housing"
- label2: "2. Impeller assembly"
- label3: "3. Mechanical seal"
- label4: "4. Bearing cartridge"

NO: human operators, factory environment photography, 3D rendered chrome reflections, lens flare, decorative gradients, rainbow palettes, cartoon mascots, watermarks, motion blur
```

## industrial_process_diagram

> Wide 16:9 industrial process-flow diagram with four labeled stages and connecting arrows.

**Artifact:** `diagram`, `1920x1088`, aspect `16:9`
**Demo vars:** `templates/industrial/_vars_examples/industrial_process_diagram.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A horizontal 16:9 industrial process-flow diagram titled Lithium Cell Pack Assembly, depicting four sequential stages laid out left-to- right inside hex or rounded-rectangle nodes, connected by arrowed lines. Each node carries its own small monochrome icon for the operation it represents (intake, process, inspect, output) and a short label.
[2. Action] The eye must trace the flow strictly from left to right with no branching, dwelling at each numbered stage long enough to read its label, then advancing along the arrow to the next. The diagram is a technical reference, not a sales artifact — it must read as a process spec.
[3. Scene] Document-grade engineering surface: a flat near-white field with very faint blueprint grid (8% opacity, cool grey) behind the nodes. No factory photography, no human operators, no perspective. The composition is engineered to print cleanly to a B-size sheet for line-side posting.
[4. Composition] 16:9 frame. Top ~10% is a title band with the process name. Below it, four equally sized nodes are arranged in a horizontal row across ~75% of the frame, separated by directional arrows. Each node has a small icon centered above its step label. Step numbers (1-4) sit in a small circle at each node's top-left corner. Bottom ~8% margin reserved for an optional revision footer.
[5. Style] Engineering documentation aesthetic — closer to a Visio / draw.io rendering than to marketing infographics. Palette: cool slate grey nodes, one safety-orange accent reserved for arrows and step numbers, charcoal type. Geometric sans-serif (Inter / Roboto family) with strict 1-pixel hairline rules around node borders. No gloss, no drop shadows, no 3D extrusion, no decorative gradients.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- title: "Lithium Cell Pack Assembly"
- step1: "1. Cell intake & barcode scan"
- step2: "2. Module stacking & welding"
- step3: "3. Pack inspection & test"
- step4: "4. Crate-out to staging bay"

NO: human operators, factory floor photography, 3D extruded nodes, glossy chrome, lens flare, decorative gradients, rainbow palettes, clip-art mascots, watermarks
```

## industrial_safety_poster

> Vertical 9:16 factory-floor safety / hazard / PPE notice for posting at line entry points.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1088x1920`, aspect `9:16`
**Demo vars:** `templates/industrial/_vars_examples/industrial_safety_poster.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A vertical 9:16 factory-floor safety poster warning of a Arc flash — 480V switchgear hazard. The composition stacks four registers top-to- bottom: a bold warning header with a large safety-orange triangular hazard glyph, the hazard description, two required actions, and a contact strip at the foot. PPE iconography (Class 2 face shield, FR coveralls) appears as small flat pictograms beneath the action lines.
[2. Action] The poster must read at a 6-meter glance — the eye registers the yellow-and-black hazard band first, the hazard label second, the required actions third, and the contact strip last. No photography, no animation; this is a static OSHA-style line-side notice.
[3. Scene] Document-grade flat field: a calibrated near-white safety-poster background with bold black border bleeding ~3% inside the frame. No factory environment behind the poster — it is rendered as the poster artifact itself, ready for laminated mounting.
[4. Composition] Vertical 9:16 frame. Top ~18% is a black-and-yellow striped warning band carrying the warning title and a triangular hazard glyph. Below ~22% holds the hazard label in heavy display type. Middle ~36% lists action_required as two stacked imperatives, each prefixed with a small flat pictogram. Bottom ~16% reserved for the PPE icon row and the contact strip. 5% safety margin around all edges.
[5. Style] OSHA / ISO 7010-style safety-signage aesthetic. Palette strictly limited to safety yellow (#FFD500), safety black, signal red, and one neutral grey. Type system: heavy condensed sans-serif on the warning header, regular sans-serif body. Pictograms are flat, silhouette-only, no gradients. No photorealism, no decorative drop shadows, no glossy chrome.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- warning_title: "WARNING: Arc flash — 480V switchgear"
- hazard_line: "Hazard: Arc flash — 480V switchgear"
- action1: "1. De-energize and verify zero voltage"
- action2: "2. PPE required: Class 2 face shield, FR coveralls"
- contact: "Report to: Maintenance ext. 2400"

NO: human models, factory photography, decorative gradients, lens flare, cartoon mascots, rainbow palettes, 3D extruded type, glossy chrome, emoji clutter, watermarks
```
